programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic

programme.desc: Using hidden cameras, host John Quiñones observes and comments on how ordinary people behave when they are confronted with dilemmas that require them either to take action or to walk by and mind their own business. Various scenarios are created that force people to make split-second -- and often surprising -- decisions, and variations of the situation (such as changing the genders, races or clothing of the people involved) are often featured to see if different reactions are elicited. programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: When can a bounty hunt also be a date? When Dog and Beth decide to ride in the same SUV as they pursue a run away fugitive, will their different approaches to the investigation lead to a capture and romance?

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Today's hunt takes Dog far from the glittering hotels of Waikiki to the parts of Hawaii tourist rarely see, Oahu's ramshackle tent cities. The team searches for a woman who has lost almost everything, her home, her family and her spirit.

programme.desc: Dog and the team must deal with misleading informants, belligerent boaters, and angry drunks when they go after Kimberly, a traffic offender with over 20 violations. And if that isn't enough, Dog has another problem -- Duane Lee is sick.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: This one is close to home. Dog's target on today's hunt is the cousin of Kali, Garry Boy's caregiver. In addition she has a reputation as a brawler. With Duane Lee still missing from the team Baby Lyssa decides she will step-up in this hunt.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: It's Dog's birthday, and he plans to celebrate in the same way he has for the last twenty years. There's no taking the day off to indulge himself for this bounty hunter--he's tracking down a fugitive!

programme.desc: Today the crew is hunting for Holly, a car thief. She's one of Tim's bonds and the entire Dog crew knows that means trouble--or at least a long and difficult chase.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Today's case involves a Samoan so Dog knows that the runner's close-knit kinfolk hold the keys to bringing him in.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog and company head to the Big Island in pursuit of two courthouse no-shows only to find that one of them appears to be posting status updates from Southern California.

programme.desc: Dog believes that the family that plays together stays together. But what happens when a family's idea of fun is getting high and running amuck? Today's case is a twofer, a brother and sister both charged with drug related offenses.

programme.desc: Dog and the team begin their day by judging the local elementary school's talent show, where they declare all the kids to be winners.

programme.title: Winchester Life

After a multi-day journey by airand sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Behind The Draw
programme.desc: I picked up a $73 water tank and turned it into a DIY deer watering hole. After placing it out and filling it up, I wanted to see how long it would take for deer to actually find it and start using it. It took 5 days before the first deer showed up, and from there the results were really cool to watch. Adding water can be a game-changer for your hunting property, especially in the hot summer and early fall months when natural water sources can be limited. In this video, I’ll walk you through the setup, show trail camera footage of the deer discovering the tank, and share what I learned from this simple experiment. If you’re thinking about creating a watering hole for deer on your land, this is one of the most affordable and effective ways to do it that I have found.

programme.title: Greg Morton
programme.sub-title: I Started Out, as a Baby
programme.desc: Greg Morton had only two choices in schoolyard conflicts. Learn the ways of the force, or use his wit to diffuse situations. That wit would soon lead to winning first prize in the, ‘So You Think You're Funny Contest' and the beginning of his stand-up comedy career. He was no longer the shy introverted kid, drawing cartoons in the corner. He had finally found his voice. A voice he would later use to direct and voice over twenty Saturday Morning cartoons. This former mobile disc jockey, who used to play songs at weddings, now sings song parodies on nationally syndicated radio shows, like the Bob and Tom Show. Take his Obama Man, sung to the tune of Candy Man, which has racked up over 4 million hits on YouTube.

programme.title: Fred Klett
programme.desc: Fred Klett has built a career from being a clean comedian, a style that is his trademark. His comedy is G-rated and focused to appeal to families with members of all ages since much of his material is taken from his experiences growing up in a large Christian family. As a mainstream performer, his brand of humor is rare and refreshing and is rooted in his faith in Christ and belief in the Holy Scriptures.

programme.title: Rex Havens
programme.desc: Rex has been delighting comedy audiences for 20 years, in world-famous comedy clubs like The Improv, Catch-A-Rising Star, Funny Bones and Zanies, on television for Showtime, Comedy Central and Comic Relief, on radio with Bob & Tom and NPR, cruise ships worldwide, and corporate clients including GM, American Express, Texaco, 3M, Coca-Cola, IBM, Toshiba, Lowe's, Johnson & Johnson, Ameritech, Proctor & Gamble, State Farm, Quaker Oats, Verizon and the IRS (“Working for the IRS is the only sure way to get money from them.”), and numerous non-profit and charitable organizations, such as St. Jude's and the Make-A-Wish Foundation. A former college professor who made the unusual transition to the standup comedy stage in the '80's, Rex has always believed that laughter is the best defense against a confusing and challenging world. Rex's take on marriage and family has propelled him to performances in all 50 states and around the world, including London, Hong Kong, Amsterdam, Bermuda, Montreal, Barcelona, Copenhagen, Aruba, Rome and Cannes.

programme.title: Tony Deyo
programme.desc: Tony Deyo is a stand-up comedian known most notably for his sharp, quick material and near-perfect comedic timing almost certainly gained from his years as a professional symphony musician. New York City's Village Voice calls him “one of the tightest joke writers in the business.” In 2013, he made his late night television debut on CONAN. Within a year, he had added appearances on The Late Late Show with Craig Ferguson, AXS TV's Gotham Comedy Live, and Comics Unleashed with Byron Allen. His latest album, Comedy Road Trip, landed on the Billboard Magazine comedy chart and debuted as the #1 selling stand-up album on iTunes. With over 50 stand-up clips available, he has steadily become one of the most prolific comedians on YouTube. He performed at the prestigious HBO Aspen Comedy Festival, was named one of the year's best by the New York Post, and can be heard regularly on SiriusXM Satellite Radio.

programme.title: Tyler Boeh
programme.desc: Who goes from being a mild-mannered nationally recognized college a Capella group vocal percussionist to becoming a high-energy, intelligent, physical, and downright silly beatboxing comedian? None other than Comedian Tyler Boeh, who shifted his focus from singing a Capella (a word he describes as Latin for “Without Girlfriend”) when he won a comedy contest in Portland Oregon. After winning and placing in the finals of numerous Comedy Competitions from San Francisco to Seattle to Boston to The World Series of Comedy, Boeh not only launched a great career in comedy including television appearances, colleges, cruise ships and headlining clubs, he also found a girlfriend. Tyler's comedy CD was chosen by LaughSpin Magazine as the Best Comedy Album of 2012 and you may have seen him on such shows as Celebrity Name Game, Moms Rule, Nesn Comedy All Stars, or heard him on SIRIUS radio. Don't miss a chance to see Tyler live.

programme.title: Shayne Smith
programme.desc: Former Gang Member, current comedian, future famous comedian. Shayne Smith is the runner up in the Wiseguys' 2015 Funniest Person In Utah competition, winner of the 2015 Salt City Comedy Superstar contest and most recently voted best Alternative Comedian of 2016 by City Weekly.

programme.title: Drew Barth
programme.desc: Drew Barth is one of the fastest rising comedy stars in the Northwest. Born just outside the city of Seattle, what started as a dare in high school has become a full-time career. Drew Barth has risen through the ranks of local open mics to become a regular performer at comedy clubs, colleges, casinos and private events up and down the West Coast. After making the finals of the Seattle International Comedy Competition, Drew Barth spent a great deal of time in Los Angeles performing at clubs such as The Comedy Store, Laugh Factory, and The Improv, honing his craft.

programme.title: Tom Mabe
programme.desc: Tom has been profiled in People magazine, called "gut-busting hilarious" by The New York Times, and given a perfect 4-star rating by the New York Post. He's been featured on radio shows from Hollywood to Dollywood, including "Bob&Tom", Johnboy & Billy "BillHandel" and "Drew&Mike". Chances are you also know Tom as the star of CMT's hit comedy series, "Mabe in America", or have watched one of his popular viral videos. With more than 50-million views on YouTube, Tom is one of the most downloaded people on the planet. People love Tom's stories about coping with life's challenges, ranging from a child with a microscopic attention span to a family vacation in a minivan that takes a wrong turn. His original songs, stories, and videos make for a night out you will remember for years.

In Crimea, a mountain has been carved into a james bondian submarine base. In northern Ukraine, the Chernobyl nuclear site has been reduced to a radioactive wasteland.

programme.title: Mad Drivers
programme.desc: Dos jóvenes ricos son aficionados a las drogas y a las carreras de autos ilegales, hasta que ocurre una tragedia.

programme.title: El superman... dilon
programme.desc: Un hombre es humillado y explotado por su mujer y su suegra, que lo obligan a hacer el quehacer de la casa, pero en las fiestas de su oficina cambia de personalidad.

programme.title: Judicial pero honrado
programme.desc: Un detective trabaja encubierto para atrapar a un narcotraficante que se dedica a lavar dinero.

programme.title: Los supersabios
programme.desc: Los supersabios construyen un cohete espacial. Panza Y Pola provocan la curiosidad de los villanos Solomillo y el médico. Los muchachos despegan su nave y se encuentran con Panza y Pola para comenzar a explorar.

programme.title: El tesoro de Moctezuma
programme.desc: Santo y dos agentes enfrentan a unos villanos cuando se tratan de robar el tesoro de Moctezuma.

programme.title: Visita al Pasado
programme.desc: Un grupo de niños que viaja a través del tiempo al siglo XVII hacen frente a un castillo embrujado.

programme.title: Santo contra el doctor Muerte
programme.desc: Santo investiga la desaparición de obras de arte originales que fueron suplantadas por copias baratas.

programme.title: El oreja rajada
programme.desc: Dos niños angustiados y un campesino hacen todo lo posible por salvar a un purasangre. El ranchero Andrés quiere deshacerse de él, pero al final reconoce los méritos del caballo.

programme.title: La mafia amarilla
programme.desc: Una pandilla china asesina a un hombre y Blue Demon, con la ayuda de su amigo, tiene que encontrar al culpable.

programme.title: Gladiadores del infierno
programme.desc: Un ex boxeador es envenenado por dos mujeres de la calle y luego recibe primeros auxilios de una muchacha drogadicta.

programme.title: El Color de Nuestra Piel
programme.desc: Una familia tiene un hijo rubio al que consiente y otro moreno que se siente desplazado aunque es bueno y trabajador.

programme.title: La cárcel de Laredo
programme.desc: Un hombre poderoso separa a su hija del novio, un mecánico, y lo envía a la prisión, a pesar de que la joven está embarazada.

programme.title: La venganza de un matón
programme.desc: María, una bailarina de salón, conoce a Ted y se enamoran. Ella queda embarazada, pero Ted sufre un accidente donde pierde la memoria y queda muy herido. Cuatro años después de su recuperación, va en busca de María.

programme.title: Zona Roja
programme.desc: Un vistazo a la vida de unas prostitutas en un puerto tropical.

programme.title: Enfrentamiento
programme.desc: Dos reos se dan cuenta de que fueron víctimas de la misma familia de mafiosos en busca de venganza.

programme.title: Mad Drivers
programme.desc: Dos jóvenes ricos son aficionados a las drogas y a las carreras de autos ilegales, hasta que ocurre una tragedia.

programme.title: Rosendo Fierro, el correo de Villa
programme.desc: Por tener acceso a cualquier lugar, un herrero es enviado por el general Villa con un mensaje importante para Zapata.

programme.title: Aventuras de un caballo blanco y un niño
programme.desc: Un niño y un caballo blanco son perseguidos por una banda de bandoleros, quienes quieren apoderarse de su oro escondido.

programme.title: Remolino
programme.desc: La historia de una mujer que juega con los sentimientos de dos hombres, haciéndolos caer en un torbellino de pasión.

programme.title: Las aventuras de Juliancito
programme.desc: Juliancito y su amigo están hartos del trato de sus papás, por lo que deciden irse a vivir a una isla y hacer creer a sus familias que están muertos para darles una lección.

programme.title: Vámonos para la feria
programme.desc: Un hombre decide que es hora de que sus dos hijos se casen. Para eso, acude a su compadre, que tiene dos bellas hijas.

programme.title: Romance en Puerto Rico
programme.desc: Una joven escapa como polizón en un barco que viaja a Puerto Rico para no casarse con un millonario.

programme.title: El bárbaro del ritmo
programme.desc: Un joven es elegido para tocar música cubana en una película y durante la filmación descubre sus propios talentos.

programme.title: Tiempo de lobos
programme.desc: Los dos hijos de un campesino vuelven de trabajar como braceros y él les reprocha que no le ayuden en el campo.

programme.title: El hacha diabólica
programme.desc: El Santo es perseguido por el encapuchado del hacha sin saber que se trata de una venganza que tiene siglos de historia.

programme.title: Historia de un marido infiel
programme.desc: Un hombre estrangula a su esposa paralítica por sus exagerados celos y su amante, que presenció todo, lo extorsiona.

programme.title: Ladrones de niños
programme.desc: Infames ladrones se van al extremo de separar niños de sus madres, con la intención de venderlos por una suma de dinero.

programme.title: Mi Alma por un Amor
programme.desc: Un viejo se enamora de una joven y vende su alma al diablo para ser joven, apuesto y rico para conquistarla en 6 meses.

programme.title: El gavilán
programme.desc: Un corrupto licenciado roba en una mina y despide al administrador sin motivos para poner a uno de sus ayudantes.

programme.title: Qué perra vida
programme.desc: Los músicos Viruta y Capulina tienen un amigo, un perro llamado Rayo, el que ha heredado una gran fortuna de su dueño.

programme.title: Mi Borinquen querida
programme.desc: Tras un accidente, una joven hereda una gran fortuna, por lo que un hombre se aprovecha del amor que despertó en ella.

programme.title: Tú y la mentira
programme.desc: La esposa de un cantante se vuelve vedette e intenta engañarlo con un cantante venezolano, que resulta ser su amigo.

programme.title: Tres melodías de amor
programme.desc: Una enamorada pareja realiza el tan añorado sueño que dos familias han tenido de unir oficialmente sus apellidos.

programme.title: El fantasma de la casa roja
programme.desc: Un hombre esconde cinco millones y los deja de herencia al familiar que descubra el lugar de la casa donde los escondió.

programme.title: Al son del mambo
programme.desc: Un millonario aburrido va a La Habana a donde lo siguen un grupo de personas y todos juntos se divierten bailando mambo.

programme.title: Mi héroe
programme.desc: Un escritor lleva a su esposa a la vieja casa de sus antepasados, donde son acechados por una serie de fantasmas.

programme.title: Espinas de una flor
programme.desc: Un joven tiene que partir y, cuando vuelve, su exnovia está casada con otro. Por esta razón, le reclama que su amor fue flor de un día.

programme.title: Los Invisibles
programme.desc: Un mago regresa a una tienda para recobrar una muñeca en la que ha escondido un diamante robado, pero no la recupera.

programme.title: Conozco a los dos
programme.desc: Un hombre mujeriego se lleva a su hija a la capital para evitar que se case con un cantante, pero el joven los sigue.

programme.title: A ritmo de twist
programme.desc: Matusalén es encargado de la tienda de trajes de baño de su tío, junto a su amigo Beto. La competencia les envía a dos hermosas mujeres a espiarlos y robar las ideas y diseños del tío.

programme.title: El Barro Humano
programme.desc: Un hombre ha herido a su esposa y en el juicio se niega a defenderse, esto obliga a reconstruir los hechos con testigos.

programme.title: Bala de Plata en el pueblo maldito
programme.desc: Un joven es herido y pierde su caballo, cuando sana reclama una mina hallada por su padre y recupera a su animal.

programme.title: Cabaret Shangai
programme.desc: Un gánster es el propietario de un cabaret donde trabaja una cantante que, a la vez, es su amante.

programme.title: Los Cinco Halcones
programme.desc: Cinco amigos, animados por el juez del pueblo, se disfrazan como halcones y luchan contra una banda de asaltantes.

programme.title: Las recién casadas
programme.desc: Tres recién casadas de distinto nivel social tienen serios problemas en su matrimonio.

programme.title: Cadetes de la Naval
programme.desc: Un hombre decide sacrificar el honor, el amor y su carrera para compartir la culpa con su amigo.

programme.title: Pasiones Tormentosas
